issues.descricao: This diff deletes the indicator editor and the aggregation control that F-2.03 delivered (commit 67f352e, 'feat(F-2.03): Editor de indicador'). It also removes the '/indicators/:id/edit' route and turns '/indicators/new' into a placeholder that says 'Em breve'. Merging it would undo F-2.03. The likely cause is that the worktree was based on a commit that is not a descendant of 67f352e (git merge-base confirms 67f352e is not an ancestor of HEAD), so the diff against the integration branch shows the editor being removed. The 'Criar meu próprio indicador' button then links to a placeholder page.
issues.sugestao: Rebase or recreate the F-2.10 work on top of the branch that contains F-2.03. Keep IndicatorEditorPage, IndicatorEditor, AggregationControl, aggregation/catalog/draft and both routes as they are, and add only the dashboard on top.

issues.descricao: Removes the e2e tests for F-2.03 (create indicator and edit-lock) and the 'indicators-edit' entry in routes.json. Tests for a feature that was already delivered are being deleted, so the gates passing here says nothing about whether F-2.03 still works.
issues.sugestao: Restore these specs and the route entry. They have to stay green alongside the new F-2.10 tests.

issues.descricao: Removes getIndicator and storedIndicatorFrom, which the F-2.03 editor uses. useIndicators now builds StoredIndicator with an inline 'as StoredIndicator' cast and no longer normalizes createdAt/updatedAt, so they may come back undefined instead of null.
issues.sugestao: Keep storedIndicatorFrom and getIndicator, and keep using storedIndicatorFrom in useIndicators.

issues.descricao: Deletes the node_modules symlinks from the repository. That is an infrastructure change the feature does not ask for, and the worker rules forbid it.
issues.sugestao: Revert the removal of the symlinks.

issues.descricao: createSuggestedIndicator copies the dailyAggregation calculation and the validation from createIndicator, which goes against the project's no-duplication rule. countActiveIndicators and countEntries also appear to be unused (listIndicatorIdentities and listEntryDates are what the code calls).
issues.sugestao: Move the shared preparation step into a helper (for example prepareIndicator(input)) used by both functions, and remove the unused exports.

issues.descricao: If the person archived the suggested indicator, createSuggestedIndicator returns false and does not reactivate it or tell the person. Tapping the suggestion again then does nothing they can see.
issues.sugestao: Either show the suggestion as unavailable or tell the person the indicator is archived, and record the decision in DECISOES.md or questions.jsonl.
